description: The data that support the findings of a review paper "From urban data to city-scale models: A review of traffic simulation case studies is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Klavdiya Bochenina (University of Helsinki). This dataset contains the data that were used in a review paper "From urban data to city-scale models: A review of traffic simulation case studies". It contains the following files: keywords with counts.txt - list of keywords and their counts in the considered corpus of traffic simulation case studies. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
